title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named Providence corridor stops within RISD’s practical orbit, each anchored by a documented arts, history, library, or performance destination.

cards.title: North Main Street: RISD Museum
cards.subtitle: North Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Approach via the documented 20 North Main Street entrance, then use the museum’s current visitor information to plan a gallery visit.
cards.short_summary: A museum entry point on the North Main Street edge of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: RISD Museum directs visitors to enter through its 20 North Main Street entrance.
cards.access_notes: The source identifies the 20 North Main Street entrance and notes that both museum entrances and galleries are wheelchair accessible.

cards.title: Benefit Street: Providence Athenæum
cards.subtitle: Benefit Street corridor
cards.notes: Check in at the Visitor Center and take the self-guided tour through this historic library’s three floors during public visiting hours.
cards.short_summary: A historic library visit with self-guided exploration on Benefit Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Providence Athenæum is at 251 Benefit Street and invites non-members to explore its three floors with a self-guided tour.
cards.access_notes: Visitor information lists 251 Benefit Street, states that all are welcome, and asks visitors to check in at the Visitor Center.

cards.title: Power Street: John Brown House Museum
cards.subtitle: Power Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the rear visitor entrance described by the museum and reserve a timed visit if you want to explore Rhode Island history inside.
cards.short_summary: A documented historic-house museum on Power Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rhode Island Historical Society locates the John Brown House Museum at 52 Power Street and describes its public history interpretation.
cards.source_title: The John Brown House Museum | Rhode Island Historical Society
cards.access_notes: The museum lists its visitor entrance at the rear and directs visitors to purchase tickets in advance.

cards.title: Empire Street: AS220
cards.subtitle: Empire Street corridor
cards.notes: Check AS220’s current program before walking over; the Empire Street complex includes gallery, performance, studio, and youth-program spaces.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit arts complex occupying the Empire Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: AS220 identifies its Empire Street Complex at 95–115 Empire Street and lists galleries, performance venues, community studios, and its youth studio there.
cards.source_title: AS220: Create, Learn, Explore, Perform, Exhibit
cards.access_notes: AS220 lists weekday public hours of 10 am–6 pm; individual program spaces may have separate schedules.

cards.title: Washington Street: AS220 Mercantile Block
cards.subtitle: Washington Street corridor
cards.notes: Look for the Mercantile Block at 131 Washington Street and check AS220’s listings for public-facing fabrication, print, gallery, or event activity.
cards.short_summary: AS220’s Washington Street building for studios and making resources.
cards.evidence_claim: AS220 locates its Mercantile Block at 131 Washington Street and lists program studios including a fabrication lab and printshop.
cards.source_title: AS220: Create, Learn, Explore, Perform, Exhibit
cards.access_notes: The source identifies the building and its listed spaces; consult AS220’s current programming for visitor availability.

cards.title: Steeple Street: WaterFire Stage
cards.subtitle: Steeple Street corridor, between North Main and Canal
cards.notes: On a scheduled WaterFire night, walk Steeple Street between North Main and Canal to locate the organization’s outdoor performance stage.
cards.short_summary: A WaterFire performance-stage stop on the short Steeple Street link.
cards.evidence_claim: WaterFire identifies its Steeple Street Stage as located on Steeple Street between North Main and Canal.
cards.access_notes: The stage is associated with WaterFire events; verify the event schedule and performance lineup before going.

cards.title: Memorial Boulevard: WaterFire
cards.subtitle: Memorial Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use WaterFire’s route guidance to walk the river parks along Memorial Boulevard during a scheduled lighting, rather than relying on one address.
cards.short_summary: A riverwalk-based public-art route along Memorial Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: WaterFire states that the installation takes place along Memorial Boulevard and the Providence and Woonasquatucket Rivers.
cards.access_notes: WaterFire says the installation spans more than a half mile in downtown river parks; confirm scheduled lighting dates before visiting.

cards.title: Westminster Street: WaterFire Ballroom
cards.subtitle: Westminster Street corridor at Weybosset Street
cards.notes: During a scheduled WaterFire Ballroom program, find the dance floor at the Westminster and Weybosset intersection and check event details first.
cards.short_summary: A documented temporary dance-floor site in the Westminster corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: WaterFire locates its Ballroom at 1 Turk’s Head Place/76 Westminster Street, at the intersection of Westminster and Weybosset Streets.
cards.access_notes: This is event programming rather than a permanently operating venue; confirm whether a Ballroom program is scheduled.

cards.title: Weybosset Street: The VETS Box Office
cards.subtitle: Weybosset Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the documented 220 Weybosset Street box-office location when you have selected an all-ages-appropriate performance on The VETS calendar.
cards.short_summary: The VETS’ event-day box office on Weybosset Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The VETS lists its on-site box office at 220 Weybosset Street and says it is open on event days.
cards.access_notes: The VETS states that its on-site box office is open only on the day of events; review the event’s age guidance before purchasing.

cards.title: Avenue of the Arts: The VETS
cards.subtitle: Avenue of the Arts corridor
cards.notes: Use the auditorium’s official calendar to choose an appropriate show, then approach the venue at One Avenue of the Arts on event day.
cards.short_summary: A major performing-arts destination on Avenue of the Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: Veterans Memorial Auditorium lists its address as One Avenue of the Arts, Providence.
cards.access_notes: Admission and access depend on the selected performance; the venue’s official calendar provides current event information.
